subject: FINAL HANDOFF: Research Agent 08 — Official Android Signal Hierarchy
body: HEAD=413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. Final: retain a strict four-layer authority model. One verified continuous source alone owns physical hinge geometry. DeviceStateManager is optional transition-edge infrastructure only and should be deleted if physical timing shows no useful lead. DisplayManager owns logical route lifecycle only; it cannot identify physical panel or first-present readiness. Use per-display state as a guard, with exact STATE_ON as the minimum visual-readiness candidate plus first-current-frame evidence before terminal handoff, pending Fold7 validation. PowerManager.isInteractive is global work/power gating only. Public Fold7 TYPE_HINGE_ANGLE remains corroboration/recovery while it is coarse. FoldingFeature/WindowInfoTracker are activity-window crease/posture information and should leave production continuity if fixed Fold7 geometry+rotation can replace them. Do not add screen-on/off fold state machinery. Delete the UI-local HingeAngleSource when service-authoritative telemetry exists. Full 14-section report stored at /DuoOpen-AgentBus/swarm/agents/08/findings/final.md.
